item_name: Failure to Complete Required Health Assessment
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol states the health assessment is required for aides prior to patient contact and annually thereafter, but it does not state an assessor observation/look-back window ending on an assessment reference date for this audit area.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A health assessment is required for aides prior to patient contact, and annually thereafter.

source.quote: A health assessment is required for aides prior to patient contact, and annually thereafter.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If documentation of a yearly health assessment is not in the personnel file of the aide who has direct patient contact, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If documentation of a yearly health assessment is not in the personnel file of the aide who has direct patient contact, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.criterion: Documentation of a yearly health assessment must be present in the personnel file of the aide who has direct patient contact.

source.quote: If documentation of a yearly health assessment is not in the personnel file of the aide who has direct patient contact, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Absence of this documentation results in claim disallowance per the OMIG Audit Criteria.

federal.criterion: Documentation must show the health assessment was completed prior to the aide's patient contact.

state_deltas.delta: This audit area is defined by the New York State Office of the Medicaid Inspector General for the Assisted Living Program, applicable to service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025; cited authorities are New York State regulations (10 NYCRR § 763.13(c)-(e) and (h); 10 NYCRR § 766.11(c) and (d)(5); 18 NYCRR § 487.9(a)(8)(i); 18 NYCRR § 488.9(a)(4) and (5); 18 NYCRR § 494.3(b)).

case_mix_relevance.notes: The document does not tie this audit area to any payment/case-mix classification; the consequence stated is disallowance of the claim, not a case-mix or rate classification change.
